scope: Breadcrumbs and operating context, not a new SITE_OWNER_ASSIGNMENT or build instruction

rules.rule: Update source JSON/manifests or renderer/style code as needed, then use the existing catalog builder. Do not solve a durable change only in generated catalog/HTML shells. Keep source IDs stable.
library.js owns hash routes, state, search, viewer and interactions; library.css owns presentation. browse_layout covers/grouping cannot change canon or source bytes.
Keep purpose filters and expandable collections, readable covers and reachable media. Routine browsing should not expose every technical preparation image.

Supporting-cast hubs bring related scenes together. Working references carry approved scoped components, angles and motion-enablement material. Ordinary hubs need representative anchors, not every viseme.
Hon defaults to All references; group by tattoo subject. Expand stencils first, then distinct body appearances and placement-guide evidence. Placement is not standalone stencil approval.
Preserve original panels, later sequences, provenance and independent asset stages. Source-panel positions and percentages are not measured song timing.
Keep scene clips and experiments intelligible, retaining each asset stage and defects. A provider name or visual polish cannot promote a clip automatically.
Use Work & handoffs, Profile, Role scorecard and Roles guide as nested information. Self-reported capabilities and earned role grades are distinct.
mission_control.json is saved work metadata. Unfinished top-priority cards appear above ordinary work; publishing a task does not execute or approve it.
Exact asset ID and original hash bind reviews. Preserve independent-field merges, explicit clears and newer direct/browser intent. Never erase an omitted field by treating it as an instruction.

Full reviews retain decisions, scene reviews, favorites and basket, including history excluded from outbound production selections. A selection manifest contains metadata; delivery still needs actual files.
Local browser state, saved review file, canonical intake and hosted app state are different. File writes are serialized; imports merge by ID/hash. Omitted favorite/basket records are not deletions.
Use the existing intake to check export freshness, autosave stability and catalog/disk hashes, and reconcile later direct user clarifications before merging.

Gold-standard likeness, scene craft, favorites, triage, lane, stage, component approval and scene readiness answer different questions. A named weaker scene reference governs only that scene. Required blockers cannot be averaged away.

Grok exploration arrives Preliminary; provider/Claude grades are attributed reviewer evidence. Preserve settled human scoped reference acceptance. Actual video action/motion and final judgment remain distinct.
Long-path aliases can be NTFS hardlinks: editing an alias changes original bytes. Do not modify aliases or originals to repair display. Preserve exact bytes and use the existing source resolver.
The compact Streamlit app and full dashboard mirror are separate views. Mirror packaging follows the local catalog build; preparation is not deployment or review synchronization.
Use one addressed mailbox file per message and explicit receipts. Posted is not received. cfa_site_index consumes only explicit site assignments, never nova production messages or acknowledgements.
